?

Psalms 85:1a MSG
…You brought good times back to Jacob!??????????

??The good times you once enjoyed..
??That beautiful marriage you once enjoyed..
??That profitable business you once had..
??That great & lofty ideas you once had..
??That thriving ministry you once had..
??Those great opportunities you once had…
?
Get ready, God is bringing them all back & even better than you knew before.. ✔

All the miserable moments you once passed through are all about to become history. (Job 11:16 MSG.. You’ll forget your troubles; they’ll be like old, faded photographs.)

YOU WILL HAVE GOOD TIMES TO RELISH THIS MONTH IN JESUS NAME
